info.title: Port_Access_Policy_Action_Set
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Policy_Action_Set](#/Port_Access_Policy_Action_Set)
The group of actions associated with this policy entry. The entries group is applied to each entry of the associated class.The entries group specified in this policy entry is defined in [Port_Access_Policy_entries] (Port_Access_Policy_entries).

cbs.description: Set the Committed Burst Size for matching packets. Associated with cir.

cir.description: Set the Committed Information Rate for matching packets.

drop.description: Drop packets matching the criteria specified in an associated class entry. If drop is specified, then all other actions will be ignored.

dscp.description: Set the Differentiated Services Code Point value of matching IPv4 and IPv6 packets to the specified value.

ecn.description: Set the Explicit Congestion Notification value of matching IPv4 and IPv6 packets to the specified value.

local_priority.description: Set the local priority of matching packets to the specified value.

origin.description: Origin of the policy action set, i.e., how the policy action set is provisioned.  `local`:           policy action set is provisioned locally on the device.  `downloaded`:      policy action set is downloaded from ClearPass server.  `radius`:          policy action set is translated from the attributes                     assigned by RADIUS server.

pcp.description: Set the Priority Code Point value of matching packets to the specified value.

redirect.description: Indicates the type of redirect action. `captive-portal`:  redirect packets to a captive portal server.

parameters.name: Port_Access_Policy.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Policy](#/Port_Access_Policy)
Name of a port-access policy.

parameters.name: Port_Access_Policy_Entry.sequence_number
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Policy_Entry](#/Port_Access_Policy_Entry)
Policy entries as configured by the user. MAC based classes are not supported in a policy entry. The entire policy is rejected if it contains one or more policy entries with MAC classes.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
